```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
```

```{r}
workflow <- png::readPNG("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel1/figures/full_longairr_scheme.png")  
workflow_plot <- ggdraw() + draw_image(workflow)


#metro <- png::readPNG("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/main/panel1/figures/metromap_transparent.png")
metro <- png::readPNG("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel1/figures/LongAIRR_new_overview.drawio.png")
metro_plot <- ggdraw() + draw_image(metro)
```


```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=8}
combined_fig1 <- plot_grid(workflow_plot + theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)),
  metro_plot + theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)),
  nrow = 2, labels = c("a", "b"), rel_heights = c(0.5, 1.22), label_size = 7)

combined_fig1
```

```{r}
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/p1.pdf", plot=combined_fig1,width = 7, height = 8)
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/p1.png", plot=combined_fig1,width = 7, height = 8)
```
